text:
julia: Quick run: regional SLA samplebench for 7B across A100 vs H100. Pinned model: vicuna-7b-v1. Promoted small run in us-west1 + eu-west1, attaching high-level numbers below and link to dashboard: https://redwood/bench/2198765432
bench-bot: Completed run 2198765432 — artifacts/summaries uploaded. Charts: tokens/sec, p50/p95 prefill+decode, $/1M tokens (region pricing incl).
li: High-level summary:
- us-west1 A100: decode 320 tok/s, end-to-end p95 210ms, prefill p95 60ms.
- us-west1 H100: decode 540 tok/s, end-to-end p95 140ms, prefill p95 45ms.
- eu-west1 A100: decode 290 tok/s, end-to-end p95 230ms.
- eu-west1 H100: decode 510 tok/s, end-to-end p95 155ms.
li: Cost calc (spot-ish price + infra): A100 us-west1 ~= $88 / 1M tokens; H100 us-west1 ~= $56 / 1M tokens (q8_0 run). eu-west1 +10% premium. Numbers are ballpark — see cost sim ticket for exact table.
aj: Nice. Did you observe kernel fallbacks or any p99 spikes?
li: We observed rare kernel fallback on A100 when sequence > 1024 during microbursts: fallback to fp16 GEMM path (latency bump ~20–30ms for those requests). p99s were dominated by those rare long-seq bursts; otherwise stable. H100 had fewer fallbacks.
omar: Memory notes: on A100 memory pressure showed up around seq=1200; forcing slice=2 reduced p99 but dropped tok/s ~8%. H100 tolerated larger kv-cache so slice=1 kept higher throughput.
li: Quant runs: q4_0 vs q8_0 vs fp16 baseline. q4_0 gives best token cost but we saw quality regressions on long-context evals (occasional truncation/artifact). q8_0 is sweet spot: ~5% worse tok/s vs q4_0 but quality within noise vs fp16.
sara: Anything different about batching across regions? Traffic shape in us-west1 produced more effective batching (higher mean batch size) which slightly improved A100 efficiency; in eu-west1 traffic was more uniform so batching gains smaller.
aj: For SLA modeling we need $/1M at committed reserved prices too — spot numbers won't cut it. I can run committed-price sim.
julia: Action items:
1) li: rerun q8_0 H100 in eu-west1 with slice=1.5 and enable new kernel flags (opt-matmul=auto).
2) aj: committed-price cost sim + table for A100 vs H100 per region.
3) omar: look at kernel fallback triggers and see if we can force stable matmul for >1024 seq on A100.
4) li: record quality failure cases for q4_0 long contexts and link to eval artifacts.
li: Command used for runs:
```
bench-run --model vicuna-7b-v1 --quant q8_0,q4_0,fp16 --gpus a100,h100 --regions us-west1,eu-west1 --seq 512,1024,2048 --payload 2000 --out s3://redwood/bench/2198765432
```
aj: I'll take item 2 and ping finance/infra for reserved price table.
julia: Thanks all — I'll drop the small summary in the weekly eng-ml channel and open the rerun ticket.
bench-bot: Note created: AB#4218 (rerun + cost-sim).
